arxiv-1804-05544.title: Building robust prediction models for defective sensor data using Artificial Neural Networks
arxiv-1804-05544.creator: Arvind Kumar Shekar, Cláudio Rebelo de Sá, Hugo Ferreira, Carlos Soares
arxiv-1804-05544.description: Abstract Predicting the health of components in complex dynamic systems such as an automobile poses numerous challenges. The primary aim of such predictive systems is to use the high-dimensional data acquired from different sensors and predict the state-of-health of a particular component, e.g., brake pad.

arxiv-1805-06881.title: Changing Observations in Epistemic Temporal Logic
arxiv-1805-06881.creator: Aurèle Barrière, Bastien Maubert, Aniello Murano, Sasha Rubin
arxiv-1805-06881.description: Abstract We study dynamic changes of agents’ observational power in logics of knowledge and time. We consider CTL ∗ ​ K \textnormal{{CTL}}^{*}\textnormal{K} , the extension of CTL ∗ \textnormal{{CTL}}^{*} with knowledge operators, and enrich it with a new operator that models a change in an agent’s way of observing the system.

arxiv-1903-04307.title: A cooperative game for automated learning of elasto-plasticity knowledge graphs and models with AI-guided experimentation
arxiv-1903-04307.creator: Kun Wang, WaiChing Sun, Qiang Du
arxiv-1903-04307.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Kun Wang, WaiChing Sun, Qiang Du. We introduce a multi-agent meta-modeling game to generate data, knowledge, and models that make predictions on constitutive responses of elasto-plastic materials. We introduce a new concept from graph theory where a modeler agent is tasked with evaluating all the modeling options recast as a directed multigraph and find the optimal path that links the source of the directed graph (e.g. strain history) to the target (e.g. stress) measured by an objective function.

arxiv-2103-16994.title: Delay Analysis of Wireless Federated Learning Based on Saddle Point Approximation and Large Deviation Theory This work is supported in part by the National Natural Science Foundation of China under Grant No. 61971264, the Beijing Natural Science Foundation under Grant No. 4191001, and Lenovo Researc
arxiv-2103-16994.creator: Lintao Li, Longwei Yang, Xin Guo, Member, IEEE , Yuanming Shi, Senior Member, IEEE , Haiming Wang, Wei Chen, Senior Member, IEEE , and Khaled B. Letaief, Fellow, IEEE
arxiv-2103-16994.description: Abstract Federated learning (FL) is a collaborative machine learning paradigm, which enables deep learning model training over a large volume of decentralized data residing in mobile devices without accessing clients’ private data. Driven by the ever increasing demand for model training of mobile applications or devices, a vast majority of FL tasks are implemented over wireless fading channels.

arxiv-2110-15865.title: Some recent advances in urban system science: models and data
arxiv-2110-15865.creator: Elsa Arcaute, José J. Ramasco
arxiv-2110-15865.description: Abstract Cities are characterized by the presence of a dense population with a high potential for interactions between individuals of diverse backgrounds. They appear in parallel to the Neolithic revolution a few millennia ago. The advantages brought in terms of agglomeration for economy, innovation, social and cultural advancements have kept them as a major landmark in recent human history.

arxiv-2201-09595.title: Towards a Real-time Measure of the Perception of Anthropomorphism in Human-robot Interaction DOI: 10.1145/3475959.3485394 Conference: Proceedings of the 2nd ACM Multimedia Workshop on Multimodal Conversational AI; October 24, 2021; Virtual Event, China Proceedings of the 2nd ACM Multimedia Workshop
arxiv-2201-09595.creator: Maria Tsfasman, Avinash Saravanan, Dekel Viner, Daan Goslinga, Sarah de Wolf, Chirag Raman, Catholijn M. Jonker, Catharine Oertel
arxiv-2201-09595.description: Abstract . How human-like do conversational robots need to look to enable long-term human-robot conversation? One essential aspect of long-term interaction is a human’s ability to adapt to the varying degrees of a conversational partner’s engagement and emotions. Prosodically, this can be achieved through (dis)entrainment.

arxiv-2312-17218.title: Spectroastrometric Survey of Protoplanetary Disks with Inner Dust Cavities
arxiv-2312-17218.creator: Stanley K. Jensen Jr, Sean D. Brittain, Andrea Banzatti, Joan R. Najita, John S. Carr, Joshua Kern, Janus Kozdon, Jonathan Zrake, Jeffrey Fung
arxiv-2312-17218.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Stanley K. Jensen Jr, Sean D. Brittain, Andrea Banzatti, Joan R. Najita, John S. Carr, Joshua Kern, Janus Kozdon, Jonathan Zrake, Jeffrey Fung. We present high-resolution spectra and spectroastrometric (SA) measurements of fundamental ro-vibrational CO emission from nine nearby ( ≲ \lesssim 300 pc) protoplanetary disks where large inner dust cavities have been observed.

arxiv-2401-16067.title: Encoding time and energy model for SVT-AV1 based on video complexity
arxiv-2401-16067.creator: Lena Eichermüller Gaurang Chaudhari Ioannis Katsavounidis Zhijun Lei Hassene Tmar Christian Herglotz André Kaup
arxiv-2401-16067.description: Abstract The share of online video traffic in global carbon dioxide emissions is growing steadily. To comply with the demand for video media, dedicated compression techniques are continuously optimized, but at the expense of increasingly higher computational demands and thus rising energy consumption at the video encoder side.

arxiv-2406-02649.title: Keyword-Guided Adaptation of Automatic Speech Recognition
arxiv-2406-02649.creator: Aviv Shamsian, Aviv Navon, Neta Glazer, Gill Hetz, Joseph Keshet
arxiv-2406-02649.description: Abstract Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) technology has made significant progress in recent years, providing accurate transcription across various domains. However, some challenges remain, especially in noisy environments and specialized jargon. In this paper, we propose a novel approach for improved jargon word recognition by contextual biasing Whisper-based models.

arxiv-2508-09841.description: Abstract . The famous Brown-Erdős-Sós conjecture from 1973 states, in an equivalent form, that for any fixed δ > 0 \delta>0 and integer k ≥ 3 k\geq 3 every sufficiently large linear 3 3 -uniform hypergraph of size δ ​ n 2 \delta n^{2} contains some k k edges spanning at most k + 3 k+3 vertices.

arxiv-2510-02313.title: Clink! Chop! Thud! – Learning Object Sounds from Real-World Interactions
arxiv-2510-02313.creator: Mengyu Yang Yiming Chen Haozheng Pei Siddhant Agarwal, Arun Balajee Vasudevan James Hays
arxiv-2510-02313.description: Abstract Can a model distinguish between the sound of a spoon hitting a hardwood floor versus a carpeted one? Everyday object interactions produce sounds unique to the objects involved. We introduce the sounding object detection task to evaluate a model’s ability to link these sounds to the objects directly involved.

arxiv-2602-09369.title: Timing and Memory Telemetry on GPUs for AI Governance ISBN: 978-X-XXXX-XXXX-X/XX/XX
arxiv-2602-09369.creator: Saleh K. Monfared, Fatemeh Ganji, Daniel Holcomb, Shahin Tajik
arxiv-2602-09369.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Saleh K. Monfared, Fatemeh Ganji, Daniel Holcomb, Shahin Tajik. The rapid expansion of GPU-accelerated computing has enabled major advances in large-scale artificial intelligence (AI), while simultaneously heightening concerns about the ability to observe, characterize, or govern how powerful accelerators are used once deployed. Governance is essential to ensure that large-scale compute infrastructure is not silently repurposed for training models, circumventing usage policies, or operating outside legal or institutional oversight.

plos-pone-0007208.title: Evolutionary Descent of Prion Genes from the ZIP Family of Metal Ion Transporters
plos-pone-0007208.creator: Gerold Schmitt-Ulms, Sepehr Ehsani, Joel C. Watts et al.
plos-pone-0007208.description: PLOS ONE research article. In the more than twenty years since its discovery, both the phylogenetic origin and cellular function of the prion protein (PrP) have remained enigmatic. Insights into a possible function of PrP may be obtained through the characterization of its molecular neighborhood in cells.

pmc-10566545.title: New Evolutionary Insights into RpoA: A Novel Quorum Sensing Reprograming Factor in Pseudomonas aeruginosa
pmc-10566545.creator: Wenjie Cai, Huimin Liao, Mingqi Lu, Xiangting Zhou, Xiaoyan Cheng, Christian Staehelin, Weijun Dai
pmc-10566545.description: Quorum-sensing (QS) coordinates the expression of virulence factors in Pseudomonas aeruginosa, an opportunistic pathogen known for causing severe infections in immunocompromised patients. QS has a master regulator, the lasR gene, but in clinical settings, P. aeruginosa isolates have been found that are QS-active but LasR-null. In this study, we developed an experimental evolutionary approach to identify additional QS-reprogramming determinants.

pmc-10648100.title: The Influence of Early Nutrition on Neurodevelopmental Outcomes in Preterm Infants
pmc-10648100.creator: Rita C Silveira, Andrea L Corso, Renato S Procianoy, Hans Demmelmair, Steven Thomas Leach
pmc-10648100.description: Premature infants, given their limited reserves, heightened energy requirements, and susceptibility to nutritional deficits, require specialized care. Aim: To examine the complex interplay between nutrition and neurodevelopment in premature infants, underscoring the critical need for tailored nutritional approaches to support optimal brain growth and function.

pmc-10775125.title: Redo aortic surgery: Does one versus multiple affect outcomes?
pmc-10775125.creator: Elizabeth L. Norton, Kanika Kalra, Bradley G. Leshnower, Jane W. Wei, Jose N. Binongo, Edward P. Chen
pmc-10775125.description: ObjectiveRedo aortic surgery has a higher risk of morbidity and mortality because it is technically complex due to mediastinal adhesions, infection, and previously implanted prostheses. In this study, we sought to benchmark our single-center experience comparing outcomes in patients undergoing aortic surgery after 1 versus multiple previous cardiac operations.MethodsBetween 2004 and 2019, 429 patients underwent redo aortic surgery.

pmc-11428057.title: Mentoring up: How mentorship training influences mentee intent to change behavior
pmc-11428057.creator: Jonathan Orsini, So Hee Hyun, Fatima Sancheznieto
pmc-11428057.description: Introduction:The purpose of this study was to evaluate data from different implementations of the Mentoring Up curriculum, designed by the Center for the Improvement of Mentored Experiences in Research. The study investigated the relationship between participants’ self-reported change in mentoring competence and the behaviors they intended to implement post-training.

pmc-13054926.title: What impact do new homologs have on detecting interdomain horizontal gene transfer in eukaryotes? A reassessment of Katz (2015)
pmc-13054926.creator: Kevin Aguirre-Carvajal, Vinicio Armijos-Jaramillo
pmc-13054926.description: The role of interdomain horizontal gene transfer (iHGT) in eukaryotic genome evolution remains a subject of ongoing debate. pmc-13309446.creator: G. Ackermann, M. Abel-Beckmann, C. Quarz, M. Halaczkiewicz, S. Stegmüller, E. Richling, G. Manolikakes, M. Christmann, J. H. Küpper, D. Schrenk, J. Fahrer
pmc-13309446.description: Estragole (ES) is a phenylpropene naturally occurring in various herbs and spices, such as fennel and basil. Humans are exposed to ES via the diet or herbal medicinal products. Following its gastrointestinal resorption, hepatic bioactivation of ES by Cytochrome P450 monooxygenases (CYPs) and sulfotransferases (SULTs) can lead to DNA adduct formation and liver cancer in rodents.

pmc-13327415.title: The first case of Reel Syndrome in a dog after pacemaker implantation: A case report
pmc-13327415.creator: Z Wojtczak, M Lewicki, M Płóciennik, J Gach, K Nowak, A Noszczyk‐Nowak
pmc-13327415.description: Reel Syndrome is a rare complication of permanent pacemaker implantation, characterised by the rotation of the device around its transverse axis, which causes the lead to coil around the generator and displacement, leading to pacing dysfunction. This report presents the first documented case of Reel Syndrome in a dog.
